name: bondi-film
description: Bondi's website video, made with Remotion. Website only; never part of the app.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts BondiFilm out/bondi-film.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=26 && remotion still src/index.ts BondiFilm out/bondi-film-poster.png --frame=470
scripts.render:stars: remotion render src/index.ts Constellation out/bondi-stars.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=22 --color-space=bt709 && remotion still src/index.ts Constellation out/bondi-stars-poster.png --frame=280
scripts.render:window: remotion render src/index.ts WindowFilm out/bondi-window.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=23 --color-space=bt709 && remotion still src/index.ts WindowFilm out/bondi-window-poster.png --frame=0
